rfp.subject: Request for proposal: team retreat 10–12 March 2027, 14 guests
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a quiet team retreat and would like a proposal for:
- Arrival 2027-03-10, departure 2027-03-12 (2 nights). Alternative arrival: 2027-03-17.
- 14 guests, 14 single rooms (28 room nights).
- One meeting room for the full group on both days, with lunch and coffee. No breakout rooms are required.
- Dietary needs: none reported. Please confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options.
- Accessibility: no wheelchair users.
- Budget: all-in total under EUR 9,000.

Please include your total price, a per-guest price, and the cancellation terms. Please reply by 2026-10-30.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
